label: IBA online BA application — Leeds Beckett award

fee.note: Plus an unspecified service charge. IBA graduates applying to another programme are exempt. Not deducted from tuition; non-refundable.

milestones.label: Submit the online BA application
milestones.note: Published 2027 summer-intake deadline; no closing time or timezone is stated.

milestones.label: Attach required documents
milestones.note: Applicants still studying provide detailed transcripts and expected graduation date. A separate final IB-results arrangement is not published; confirm with IBA.

milestones.label: IBA must receive application fee
milestones.note: DKK 750 plus service charge; IBA-graduate exemption. Pay through the programme-linked 2027 autumn LBU payment option and attach receipt.

milestones.label: Reply to an admission offer
milestones.note: Follow the individual offer instructions; no public 2027 reply date is recorded.

submissionItems.label: Upper-secondary diploma and transcripts, or current transcripts before graduation
submissionItems.note: Before graduation include the expected date of completion. No specific predicted-IB form or final-results delivery mechanism is published.

submissionItems.label: Accepted English-language documentation or approved exemption
submissionItems.note: Resolve the TOEFL discrepancy and IB English-medium exemption with IBA/LBU before relying on them.

submissionItems.label: Valid passport or national ID copy
Application fee payment receipt, unless exempt

supplementarySteps: An online meeting is offered to applicants. Relevant professional experience and optional additional qualifications can be included; a compulsory interview is not stated.
Agree final IB-result delivery and the exact English-proof conditions with IBA before relying on the published general checklist.

notes: This direct online LBU BA route does not use Optagelse.dk or the Danish national March deadline. It does not establish dates for the separate Coventry BSc or BME routes.
